Fictional outpatient letter | generated-005 | age 45
Consultation: 2025-02-01

At this routine outpatient review, the established diagnosis remains focal epilepsy.

The patient describes the same brief focal impaired-awareness seizures, with 1 to 2 per month between 1 October 2024 and today, 1 February 2025. The most recent occurred on 20 January 2025. Asked about the entire period, the patient reports no other event types.

Fictional outpatient letter | generated-005 | age 45
Consultation: 2025-07-31

The following diagnosis is copied as background from the February letter: the diagnosis remains focal epilepsy.

For the period from 2 February to 31 July 2025, the patient reports continued activity of the same focal impaired-awareness pattern at 1 to 2 seizures per month. The last was on 20 July 2025. There have been no other event types anywhere in this interval.
